decks.notes: This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures in the Dimir color combination to quickly overwhelm your opponent. The creatures have abilities that disrupt your opponent's game plan, while also providing card advantage and potential control elements. The deck also includes removal spells to deal with any threats your opponent may present. The mana base is a mix of lands that provide both black and blue mana, ensuring you have the resources needed to play your spells efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game throughout.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Sentinel of the Nameless City. It also utilizes removal spells like Maelstrom Pulse and Go for the Throat to control the opponent's threats. The deck includes a mix of creatures with powerful abilities, such as Wrenn and Realmbreaker and Thrun, Breaker of Silence, to further pressure the opponent. By combining efficient creatures with removal and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, taking advantage of the Dimir color combination for efficient removal and control. The deck includes a mix of cheap creatures and spells to apply pressure early in the game, supported by utility cards like Faerie Mastermind and Gix's Command. The inclusion of cards like Enduring Curiosity and Tishana's Tidebinder allow for card advantage and tempo plays, while the deck's mana base enables smooth casting of spells across both black and blue colors.

This Gruul Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and powerful pump spells to quickly take control of the game. By utilizing cards like Turn Inside Out, Might of the Meek, and Monstrous Rage, the deck can quickly pump up its creatures and deal massive amounts of damage. Slickshot Show-Off and Heartfire Hero also provide additional ways to deal damage and control the board, while Leyline of Resonance helps to further amplify the deck's aggressive strategy. With a focus on speed and power, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the board and disrupt your opponent's plays through a combination of board wipes, removal spells, and disruptive effects. By efficiently managing your opponent's resources and controlling the game state, you aim to outlast them and take over the game with powerful late-game threats like Overlord of the Mistmoors and Zur, Eternal Schemer. The deck also includes some lifegain and card draw engines to sustain you through the game and ensure you have the resources you need to achieve victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of disruptive spells and aggressive creatures. Utilizing cards like Hopeless Nightmare and Spyglass Siren to control the board and stall your opponent's plans, while beating down with efficient threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and keep the pressure on your opponent, leading to quick victories through a mixture of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive strategy using powerful Golgari creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The combination of early creature threats like Preacher of the Schism and Mosswood Dreadknight, backed up by removal spells like Go for the Throat and Maelstrom Pulse, allows the deck to control the board while dealing damage at a rapid pace. With a mix of versatile removal, efficient creatures, and disruptive spells, this Aggro Golgari deck aims to outpace and outmuscle the opponent to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and creature abilities. It utilizes powerful control cards like Day of Judgment and Leyline Binding to keep the opponent's board in check. Cards like Zur, Eternal Schemer and Temporary Lockdown help to lock down the opponent's resources and prevent them from mounting a strong offense. The deck also includes a variety of versatile creatures and lands to ensure consistent mana production and card advantage. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game until you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and spells.

The main focus of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up resources and creating a strong defensive board presence. Using a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide card advantage and flexibility, such as Stock Up and Stormchaser's Talent. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and eventually overwhelm the opponent with its strong defensive and disruptive capabilities.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, using efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. It includes a mix of low-cost creatures with haste and direct damage spells to maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and to ensure the deck can cast its spells on curve. The strategy is to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, utilizing burn spells and combat tricks to clear the way for heavy damage. The goal is to quickly deplete the opponent's life total, utilizing cards like Heartfire Hero, Emberheart Challenger, and Monastery Swiftspear to apply pressure. The deck includes a mix of creatures and burn spells to maintain a consistent stream of threats, maintaining a fast and aggressive playstyle to secure victory.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while building up resources for a strong late-game. Utilizing a variety of removal spells, creature control cards, and card draw effects, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent. Key cards such as Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Hopeless Nightmare provide threats while disruption cards like Fear of Isolation and Nowhere to Run keep the opponent on their toes. With a well-balanced mana base and a mix of control elements, this deck aims to control the game until it can secure a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Spyglass Siren and Cut Down. By using tempo plays like Phantom Interference and Gix's Command, the deck aims to control the board while pressuring the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent gameplay. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this Aggro Azorius deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Mockingbird and Warden of the Inner Sky, supported by protection spells like Protect the Negotiators. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with evasive threats like Spyglass Siren and close out the game before the opponent can establish their game plan. The inclusion of card draw in Enduring Curiosity helps maintain resources while Restless Anchorage provides additional versatility. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and disrupt their plays with countermagic.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures and using removal spells to control the board. Cards like Gix's Command and Maelstrom Pulse help disrupt opponents' strategies while creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Thrun, Breaker of Silence provide powerful threats. The mana base is designed to allow for consistent and efficient casting of spells, with a mix of lands that provide both green and black mana sources. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells, establishing dominance on the battlefield.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's plans through a combination of removal spells, counter magic, and creatures that generate value when they enter the battlefield. By controlling the board with efficient removal and countering key spells, you can outlast your opponent and win the game through attrition. The deck also has a strong late-game presence with powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Hopeless Nightmare, ensuring that you can close out the game once you have gained control.
